title.english: Hind bint al-Muqawwim ibn Abd al-Muttalib
title.arabic_observed: هند بنت المقوّم بن عبد المطلب

segments.arabic:
١١٨٦٦- هند بنت المقوّم بن عبد المطلب
بن هاشم.
ذكرها ابن سعد، وأنّ أبا عمرة الأنصاريّ تزوّجها، فولدت له عبد الرّحمن، وعبد اللَّه، وقال: أمها قلابة بنت عمرو بن جعونة السّهميّة.
segments.english:
11866—Hind bint al-Muqawwim ibn Abd al-Muttalib
ibn Hashim.

Ibn Sa'd mentioned her and stated that Abu Amra al-Ansari married her and that she bore him Abd al-Rahman and Abd Allah. He said: “Her mother was Qulaba bint Amr ibn Ja'una al-Sahmiyya.”

names.arabic: قلابة بنت عمرو بن جعونة السّهميّة
names.english: Qulaba bint Amr ibn Ja'una al-Sahmiyya

unresolved.explanation: The final text provisionally retains “Qulaba.” The canonical Arabic and the supplied Urdu and Arabic witnesses preserve only the consonantal spelling and do not determine whether the first vowel is u or i.
The final text provisionally retains “Ja'una.” The unvocalized witnesses do not safely distinguish Ja'una from Ja'wana or another possible vocalization.
